Date: Tue, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing - request for invoice-only routing (no PO)

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudStitch is excited to kick off the 6-week pilot. Our procurement team asked me to confirm billing for the initial pilot: CloudStitch prefers to issue invoices without a Redwood PO for pilots under $20k to avoid internal lead time.

I've attached our onboarding form and W-9 for your team to process. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept an invoice-only path for this pilot and if any temporary controls are needed (invoice/term limits, evidence, etc.)?

Attachments:
- cloudstitch_onboarding_form.pdf (completed)
- vendor_w9.pdf

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Partnerships
CloudStitch AI
elena@cloudstitch.ai

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing - request for invoice-only routing (no PO)

Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the paperwork. I reviewed the onboarding form and W-9; looks complete. We can run a temporary invoice-only path for pilots, but we need procurement and finance sign-off with the following guardrails suggested on our side:

- Pilot cap: $15,000 total (invoices must not exceed this over the 6-week period)
- Duration: 60-day invoice-only pilot window
- Evidence: signed SOW + W-9 required (already attached)
- Renewal: any ongoing engagement will require a standard PO and SOW update

Marissa / Priyom — could procurement confirm whether this fits Redwood's temporary exception criteria? If approved, Laura in finance will need to log the exception and set invoice routing instructions (payable to CloudStitch AI).

Next steps for CloudStitch: please attach the signed SOW (if available) and confirm the expected total for the pilot so we can route for approval.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Jonas / Elena —

Thanks for the materials. Quick procurement assessment: CloudStitch is a low-risk vendor based on their public profile and the limited pilot scope, so an invoice-only exception is reasonable with controls. Required items before procurement signs off:

- Completed onboarding form (received)
- Valid W-9 on file (received)
- Signed SOW or email confirmation of scope/value (requested)
- Vendor tier set to "pilot - temporary" in system (procurement will assign)

Procurement exception criteria for this path (summary):
- Single-pilot cap <= $20k OR monthly run-rate <= $5k
- Finance approval required for any invoice > $10k
- Procurement to log exception with audit note and expiration date (60 days)

Elena: please share the signed SOW or an explicit written confirmation of pilot total. Once we have that, I'll create the exception record and loop Finance (Laura) for the invoice limit.

Attachments: procurement_temp_exception_checklist.pdf (internal)

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager

Finance has reviewed the packet (onboarding form, W-9, and SOW confirmation). We will approve a one-time invoice-only pilot for CloudStitch with the following conditions:

1) Pilot cap: $12,000 total (single invoice allowed up to $12k)
2) Exception window: 60 calendar days from 2028-07-20
3) Invoice routing: Invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.com with "CloudStitch Pilot - CRM-3419" in the subject; AP will route to the assigned approver in finance.
4) Renewal: Any extension or recurring work must be processed with a standard PO before additional invoices are accepted.
5) Audit: Procurement will record the exception and tag it for a 90-day post-pilot review.

Elena — once you send the signed SOW (signed_sow_cloudstitch.pdf) to invoices@redwood.com and include the CloudStitch remit details on the invoice, AP will process according to the above.
